changes.comment: An `agents[].config` block for a `builtin:claude-code`/`npm:`-claude-code-runtime provider now follows the same persisted-shape policy (R21) as the rest of config.json: an unrecognized key (`bin`, `model`, `permission_mode`, `remote_control`, `extra_args`, `extra_env`, `turn_timeout_ms`) is tolerated and ignored instead of refusing `dreamux serve`. Wrong types and missing required fields still fail loading.
